parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the basic GA instance.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the endpoint group.

The description can be up to 200 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupRegion
parameters.description:
The ID of the region to which the endpoint group belongs.

You can call the [ListAvailableBusiRegions](~~2253223~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: EndpointSubAddress
parameters.description:
The secondary address of the endpoint.

You must specify this parameter when the accelerated IP address is associated with the secondary private IP address of an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance or an elastic network interface (ENI).

*   When the endpoint type is **ECS**, you can set **EndpointSubAddress** to the secondary private IP address of the primary ENI. If the parameter is left empty, the primary private IP address of the primary ENI is used.
*   If the endpoint type is **ENI**, you can set **EndpointSubAddress** to the secondary private IP address of the secondary ENI. If the parameter is left empty, the primary private IP address of the secondary ENI is used.

parameters.name: EndpointType
parameters.description:
The type of the endpoint. Valid values:

*   **ENI**
*   **SLB**
*   **ECS**

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the endpoint group.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the GA instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga create-basic-endpoint-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --endpoint-group-region cn-shanghai --name group1 --description BasicEndpointGroup --biz-endpoint-type ENI --endpoint-address eni-bp1a05txelswuj8g0000 --endpoint-sub-address 172.16.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga CreateBasicEndpointGroup --region cn-hangzhou --EndpointGroupRegion 'cn-shanghai' --Description BasicEndpointGroup --EndpointType ENI --EndpointSubAddress '172.16.XX.XX' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --AcceleratorId 'ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000' --Name group1 --EndpointAddress 'eni-bp1a05txelswuj8g0000'
